description:
Create the Rust helper crate skeleton for the v2 native/helper replay engine. Pure scaffolding only — no PipeWire, no ffmpeg, no encoder, no real frames. The point is to land an empty-but-buildable helper binary, a place for the JSON-RPC server to attach, and the directory layout the rest of the series will fill in.

Scope (binding):
- Add a Cargo workspace (or extend an existing one) with a new crate `cove-replay-engine` producing a binary named `cove-replay-engine` (no `.exe` suffix in source; cargo handles Windows).
- Crate directory layout:
  - `helper/` (or `crates/cove-replay-engine/`) at repo root, alongside existing `electron/` and `src/`. Final location is implementer's choice but MUST be documented in repo README and `RELEASES.md` is NOT touched in this ticket.
  - `src/main.rs` — entrypoint, parses `--ipc-socket`, `--log-dir`, `--log-level`, `--print-protocol-version` flags per N-007 §9.1. `--print-protocol-version` prints the integer `protocolVersion` constant and exits 0.
  - `src/lib.rs` — re-exports module roots.
  - Module stubs (empty but `pub`): `protocol`, `transport`, `capture`, `encoder`, `segment`, `export`, `engine`, `diagnostics`. Each module compiles with `pub fn _placeholder() {}` only.
- `Cargo.toml`:
  - Edition 2021. Pin Rust toolchain in `rust-toolchain.toml` (stable). MSRV not enforced beyond pinning.
  - Dependencies kept minimal: `tokio` (rt-multi-thread, macros, io-util, net, sync, signal), `serde`/`serde_json`, `tracing`/`tracing-subscriber`, `anyhow`/`thiserror`, `clap` (derive). No `pipewire-rs`, no ffmpeg crates yet — those land in later tickets.
- Constants: `PROTOCOL_VERSION: u32` and `HELPER_VERSION: &str = env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION")` exposed from `protocol::version`. Initial `PROTOCOL_VERSION = 1`.
- Logging: `tracing-subscriber` initialised in `main.rs` honouring `--log-level` (`error|warn|info|debug|trace`); writes JSON-line records to `<log-dir>/engine.log`. Stdout/stderr from the binary are still inherited (so Electron supervisor can capture them per N-007 §9.1).
- Build behaviour: `cargo build -p cove-replay-engine` produces a binary that, when run with no args, exits with a non-zero code and a clear message telling the operator the helper is invoked by the Electron main process. `--print-protocol-version` prints `1` and exits 0.

Out of scope (binding):
- No JSON-RPC transport (T-012).
- No Electron-side spawning or supervisor wiring (T-013).
- No preload/renderer changes (T-014).
- No PipeWire/portal/ffmpeg/encoder code (T-016..T-019).
- No package.json changes, no electron-builder changes, no `extraResources` config — that lands when the helper actually does something useful (T-020 or later).
- No CI workflow additions. Do not edit any GitHub Actions YAML.
- No SHA-256 sidecar generation. Sidecars are a release-time concern (T-010d).
- No tests beyond a single `cargo test -p cove-replay-engine` doctest or smoke unit that asserts `PROTOCOL_VERSION == 1`.

Acceptance criteria:
1. `cargo build -p cove-replay-engine` succeeds on Linux.
2. `cargo build -p cove-replay-engine --release` succeeds on Linux.
3. `./target/debug/cove-replay-engine --print-protocol-version` prints `1` and exits 0.
4. `./target/debug/cove-replay-engine` with no args prints a one-line message and exits non-zero.
5. The module stubs (`protocol`, `transport`, `capture`, `encoder`, `segment`, `export`, `engine`, `diagnostics`) all exist and compile.
6. No edits outside the helper crate directory + `Cargo.toml`/`Cargo.lock`/`rust-toolchain.toml` at repo root.

Verification commands:
- `cargo build -p cove-replay-engine`
- `cargo build -p cove-replay-engine --release`
- `./target/debug/cove-replay-engine --print-protocol-version`
- `cargo test -p cove-replay-engine`
- `git status --short`

Codex review expectations:
- Confirm crate layout matches the modules called out above and that the binary name is `cove-replay-engine`.
- Confirm only the helper crate + workspace root Cargo files are touched.
- Confirm `PROTOCOL_VERSION` is exposed from `protocol::version` and printed correctly by the flag.
- Confirm no PipeWire / ffmpeg dependencies were added.
- Flag any feature creep beyond scaffolding.

Failure handling:
- If a Rust workspace setup decision (single-crate workspace vs nested workspace vs add-to-existing) is ambiguous, default to a workspace at repo root with the helper as the only member. Document the choice in the helper crate README only; do not touch top-level project docs.

No commits, tags, or publishes from this ticket.
title: Scaffold native/helper replay engine package (cove-replay-engine)
